query:
If the weather is fine, Xiao Liu will go on an outing. If his wife does not go with him, Xiao Liu will not go on an outing; if there is an emergency in the unit, Xiao Liu will not go on an outing; if today is not Saturday, Xiao Liu will not go on an outing.

Assuming that the above statement is correct, then Xiao Liu cannot determine that today is Saturday if he goes on an outing.

repl_history.response:
GLOBAL CONTEXT PREVIEW shows that if "today is not Saturday", Xiao Liu will not go on an outing. If Xiao Liu goes on an outing, then today must be Saturday (because all other conditions for the outing would have been broken). Therefore, if Xiao Liu goes on an outing, he cannot determine that today is Saturday.

FINAL ANSWER: CannotDetermine
